items.title: How much does 1:1 frequency affect how fast a hidden concern actually surfaces?
items.description: Assume it typically takes about 3 report-led 1:1s of consistently protected time before a report trusts the opening enough to raise something they've been sitting on — a career concern, friction with a teammate. Drag the cadence slider to see how spacing meetings further apart stretches out that wait, even though the number of meetings needed stays exactly the same.
items.compute: const meetingsNeeded = 3; const days = params.cadenceDays * meetingsNeeded; return { days };
